title: Competitor capability time-series and deployment compatibility playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: build a repeatable playbook that (1) captures time-series trends in competitor model capabilities and feature rollouts, and (2) maps deployment compatibility vectors (quantization formats, GPU affinity, VPC/private availability, API surface parity) to Redwood product impact. Deliverables: a data ingest pipeline for monthly competitor feature snapshots, a scored time-series dashboard with drift alerts, and a canonical deployment-compatibility matrix for the top 12 public/open models across hardware families and hosting modes. This will feed roadmap signals for Redwood Optimize, Dedicated capacity planning, and private deployment readiness.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly time-series ingest of feature and performance signals for >=12 models for the past 6 months (latency, token-cost proxy, new features e.g., tool-calling, structured output support)

Deployment compatibility matrix covering: quantization formats supported, recommended inference backend (e.g., Triton/ONNX/custom runtime), max sequence lengths with trimmed memory, recommended batch strategy, and private/VPC availability for each model variant
Dashboard with three drift detectors (feature velocity, latency delta vs baseline, and API contract changes) and email/Slack alerts wired to PM + Eng on-call

Playbook doc with step-by-step triage actions, priority rules for model onboarding, and a decision rubric linking signals to product actions (e.g., add to model catalog, de-prioritize, or allocate Dedicated capacity)
tasks: Inventory candidate models and canonicalize variant names (owner: Diego)
Define telemetry schema and fields for time-series (owner: DataOps)
Implement monthly scraper + manual triage workflow for closed-source release notes and community signals (owner: Research)
Prototype compatibility matrix in Google Sheets and migrate to BigQuery table (owner: Eng Data)
Design dashboard mockups in Looker Studio + identify metrics for drift detectors (owner: PM/DX)
Run pilot with 3 models covering different vendors/hardware (owner: Runtime Eng)
Write playbook with triage runbooks and publish to Confluence (owner: Aisha)
Stakeholder review session with Console, Dedicated, and Private leads (owner: Diego)
